title: DFIR Triage Scope Config
description: The scope-config contract for -ScopeConfig. Dimensions: parse / hunt / focus. Unknown keys are rejected on load. Precedence: CLI parameters > scope config > config.json defaults.

layout.description: Collection format. Must match a key in layouts.json. Used only when -Layout is not given on the command line.

hypothesis.description: Free-text analyst hypothesis (documentation only; does not change parsing).

addArtifacts.description: Logical artifact names from artifacts.json to add on top of the tier (e.g. LogFile, Secure, NTUSER).

skipArtifacts.description: Artifacts to deliberately skip. These are reported as 'configured to skip', NOT as clean.

hunt.description: DIMENSION 2 - what to hunt. All optional; empty is valid.

iocFiles.description: Paths/globs to IOC list files (hashes, filenames, IPs, domains, strings). Empty = Sigma only.

focus.description: DIMENSION 3 - time focus. Applied to the timeline and *_filtered.csv outputs.

timeStart.description: ISO 8601 UTC lower bound for timeline/detections.
